WorldLifetime has compiled but its body has not run. Input cleanup is queued behind the comparison. The movement-origin security gap remains a documented proposal. M3/M4 are not implemented; their full work orders remain below, with reviewed M3 reward/UI contracts prepared.

Exact next: root finishes frozen seed1104, then1105, final crowd/CPU capture and M2 engineering checkpoint. Proceed to M3 implementation while human/device acceptance stays open. No publication, Creator Dashboard, sales, live DataStores or place settings were changed. All notes are indexed in [launch/README](launch/README.md).
